title: Distill a liquid from a solution
subject: chemistry

steps.instruction: Pour the ink solution into the distillation flask.
Connect the condenser with cold water flowing in at the lower end.
Place the receiving flask under the condenser outlet.
Heat gently and collect the clear distillate.

rules.feedback: The ink solution fills the distillation flask.
The condenser is connected with water flow entering at the bottom.
The receiving flask is positioned to collect the distillate.
Water vapor travels through the condenser and condenses in the receiving flask.

outcomes.title: Water distilled
outcomes.description: Clear water (distillate) collects in the receiving flask while ink residue remains in the distillation flask.

safeFailure.message: Check your setup and try again.
safeFailure.guidance: Ensure condenser water is flowing before heating and the receiving flask is positioned correctly.

narration.text: Pour the ink solution into the distillation flask. Fill it about three quarters full.
Connect the Liebig condenser. Cold water should enter at the bottom and exit at the top.
Place the receiving flask under the condenser outlet to catch the distillate.
Heat gently. Watch for the thermometer to reach 100 degrees Celsius. Water vapor will travel through the condenser.
